item.title: N - Wikipedia
item.description: In English, n usually represents a voiced alveolar nasal /n/, but can represent other nasal consonants due to assimilation. For example, before a velar plosive (as in ink or jungle), n represents a voiced velar nasal /ŋ/.

item.title: The Letter N – Made Easy
item.description: Writing the letter N is simple and can be enjoyable. To write the uppercase N, start at the top, draw a straight line down, then go back up to the top left and draw a diagonal line down to the bottom right. Finally, draw another straight line from the bottom to the top right.
